title: Bounded etale witnesses for finite reduction and open extension
statement:
Fix the finite-field and coefficient datum [def-weil-finite-field-fiber] and $A=A_{E,n}	o B=A_{E,m}$ with $1\le m\le n$. Let $j:X\hookrightarrow Z$ be an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion] and $K\in D^b_c(X_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$ (bounded, with cohomology sheaves constructible in the sense of [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf]) have Tor amplitude $[a,b]$ [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]. Write $S_T=-\otimes^L_AB$ [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings] on either site, $U_T$ for exact scalar restriction [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars], and $
u_T^*$ for the etale/pro-etale comparison [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. There is $K_e\in D^b_c(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ [def-weil-pbc-constructible-complexes] with $
u_X^*K_e\cong K$. Put $E_e=j_!^{\mathrm{et},A}K_e$ [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero]. Then $K_e,E_e,S_X^{\mathrm{et}}K_e,S_Z^{\mathrm{et}}E_e$ are bounded in their respective coefficient categories. The last two have cohomology only in $[a,b]$. The canonical B-linear comparisons
$$
u_X^*S_X^{\mathrm{et}}K_e\cong S_XK,\qquad 
u_Z^*S_Z^{\mathrm{et}}E_e\cong j_!^BS_XK$$
give bounded etale-origin witnesses [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness], and $
u_Z^*E_e\cong j_!^AK$. The underlying A-complexes $K_e\otimes_A^LB$ and $E_e\otimes_A^LB$ are bounded as well.

proof.text: Take a flat complex P supported in [a,b] representing K; it is K-flat because it is bounded above. Sheafified scalar extension E followed by exact conservative restriction U is tensor by the constant target coefficient module. Hence E preserves quasi-isomorphisms between K-flat complexes. The transpose of the ordinary adjunction unit computes any chosen left adjoint to D(U) on P. Apply this to the published pbcFixedScalarExtension. The complex E(P) retains its zero terms outside [a,b], so the reduction is concentrated in that interval over B.

Step 1: clause (ii) of lem-sf-proetale-constructible-origin holds for any scheme and A_{E,n}, with the same intrinsic constructibility notion as the item. Step 2: lem-pur-coefficient-pullback-comparison applied to nu^{-1} and constant A->B gives the B-linear derived iso; exactness comes from prop-weil-pbc-site-comparison-finite-level. Step 3: a flat-term K-flat P computes both S_T and the restricted -⊗^L_A B (lem-pur-change-of-rings-tensor-comparison, def-weil-derived-tensor, def-kun-derived-tensor); the Tor-amplitude definition is applied to M=B, so no flatness of B is used. Step 4: both j_! and nu^* are exact, so the sheaf comparison lifts termwise to D. Step 5: beta_j from the same-unit lem-fix-open-scalar-tensor-normalization (first paragraph), and exactness of j_!^B gives the [a,b] range. Step 6: the bounds are reflected to the étale side by exactness plus the unit F≅nu_*nu^*F at finite B; this is elementary, and D^+ is established before def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness is used. Edge cases j=id, X empty, A=B and non-flat Z/l^2->Z/l are all consistent. No duplicate found in the DAG. All nine declared off-unit tool_uses are accepted.

theorem reduction_open_etale_origin
    (D : WeilConjectures.FiniteFieldDatum.{u})
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (_hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (m n : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hmn : m ≤ n)
    {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : X ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (K : _root_.DerivedCategory (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (coefficient l E n))))
    (_hc : ∀ q : ℤ, @Scheme.IsConstructibleProEtaleFixedModuleSheaf X
      (coefficient l E n) _
      (Equiv.ulift.finite_iff.mpr
        (Padic.finite_coefficientExtensionRing l E n (hm.trans hmn)))
      ((_root_.DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj K))
    (_hb : _root_.DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.bounded K)
    (a b : ℤ) (_hab : a ≤ b)
    (_ht : DerivedCategory.torAmplitudeIn (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (coefficient l E n)) X a b K) :
    ∃ Ke : Etale.DerivedCategoryModule (coefficient l E n) X,
      @Etale.DerivedCategory.isBoundedConstructible (coefficient l E n) _
        (Equiv.ulift.finite_iff.mpr
          (Padic.finite_coefficientExtensionRing l E n (hm.trans hmn))) X Ke ∧
      ∃ α : (nu (coefficient l E n) X).obj Ke ≅ K,
        _root_.DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.bounded Ke ∧
        _root_.DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.bounded
          ((etaleOpen (coefficient l E n) j).obj Ke) ∧
        _root_.DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.bounded
          ((@pbcFixedScalarExtension.{u} X.Etale inferInstance
          (essentiallySmallSelf.{0, u, u + 1} _) X.smallEtaleTopology
          _ _ inferInstance inferInstance (coefficientMap l E m n hmn)).obj Ke) ∧
        _root_.DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.bounded
          ((@pbcFixedScalarExtension.{u} Z.Etale inferInstance
          (essentiallySmallSelf.{0, u, u + 1} _) Z.smallEtaleTopology
          _ _ inferInstance inferInstance (coefficientMap l E m n hmn)).obj
            ((etaleOpen (coefficient l E n) j).obj Ke)) ∧
        _root_.DerivedCategory.homologyConcentratedIn a b
          ((@pbcFixedScalarExtension.{u} X.Etale inferInstance
          (essentiallySmallSelf.{0, u, u + 1} _) X.smallEtaleTopology
          _ _ inferInstance inferInstance (coefficientMap l E m n hmn)).obj Ke) ∧
        _root_.DerivedCategory.homologyConcentratedIn a b
          ((@pbcFixedScalarExtension.{u} Z.Etale inferInstance
          (essentiallySmallSelf.{0, u, u + 1} _) Z.smallEtaleTopology
          _ _ inferInstance inferInstance (coefficientMap l E m n hmn)).obj
            ((etaleOpen (coefficient l E n) j).obj Ke)) ∧
        _root_.DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.bounded
          ((Sheaf.derivedRestrictScalars X.smallEtaleTopology (coefficientMap l E m n hmn)).obj
            ((@pbcFixedScalarExtension.{u} X.Etale inferInstance
          (essentiallySmallSelf.{0, u, u + 1} _) X.smallEtaleTopology
          _ _ inferInstance inferInstance (coefficientMap l E m n hmn)).obj
              Ke)) ∧
        _root_.DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.bounded
          ((Sheaf.derivedRestrictScalars Z.smallEtaleTopology (coefficientMap l E m n hmn)).obj
            ((@pbcFixedScalarExtension.{u} Z.Etale inferInstance
          (essentiallySmallSelf.{0, u, u + 1} _) Z.smallEtaleTopology
          _ _ inferInstance inferInstance (coefficientMap l E m n hmn)).obj
              ((etaleOpen (coefficient l E n) j).obj Ke))) ∧
        ∃ (hx : _root_.DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.plus
            ((@pbcFixedScalarExtension.{u} X.ProEt inferInstance
              (essentiallySmallSelf.{0, u, u + 1} _) (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
              _ _ inferInstance inferInstance
              (coefficientMap l E m n hmn)).obj K))
          (hz : _root_.DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.plus
            ((proEtaleOpen (coefficient l E m) j).obj
              ((@pbcFixedScalarExtension.{u} X.ProEt inferInstance
              (essentiallySmallSelf.{0, u, u + 1} _) (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
              _ _ inferInstance inferInstance
                (coefficientMap l E m n hmn)).obj K)))
          (wx : Scheme.FixedEtaleOriginWitness X (coefficient l E m)
            ⟨(@pbcFixedScalarExtension.{u} X.ProEt inferInstance
              (essentiallySmallSelf.{0, u, u + 1} _) (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
              _ _ inferInstance inferInstance
              (coefficientMap l E m n hmn)).obj K, hx⟩)
          (wz : Scheme.FixedEtaleOriginWitness Z (coefficient l E m)
            ⟨(proEtaleOpen (coefficient l E m) j).obj
              ((@pbcFixedScalarExtension.{u} X.ProEt inferInstance
              (essentiallySmallSelf.{0, u, u + 1} _) (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
              _ _ inferInstance inferInstance
                (coefficientMap l E m n hmn)).obj K), hz⟩),
          wx.complex.obj =
            (@pbcFixedScalarExtension.{u} X.Etale inferInstance
          (essentiallySmallSelf.{0, u, u + 1} _) X.smallEtaleTopology
          _ _ inferInstance inferInstance (coefficientMap l E m n hmn)).obj Ke ∧
          HEq wx.iso (reductionComparison (coefficientMap l E m n hmn) α) ∧
          wz.complex.obj =
            (@pbcFixedScalarExtension.{u} Z.Etale inferInstance
          (essentiallySmallSelf.{0, u, u + 1} _) Z.smallEtaleTopology
          _ _ inferInstance inferInstance (coefficientMap l E m n hmn)).obj
              ((etaleOpen (coefficient l E n) j).obj Ke) ∧
          HEq wz.iso (openReductionComparison (coefficientMap l E m n hmn) j α) ∧
          Nonempty ((nu (coefficient l E n) Z).obj
            ((etaleOpen (coefficient l E n) j).obj Ke) ≅
              (proEtaleOpen (coefficient l E n) j).obj K)
